question.problem:
Change the order of integration and evaluate the double integral 
${\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{y}^{2}{e}^{-{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y.$
question.worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14226206/assets/79326f0f463d3b26db4ab497045fa35aa5aa7fb68be6fd79b5ebd633a4d6646f.png)

The diagram above shows the region of integration. This is a type II region, and its type II representation is

$$
D=\{(x,y)\,:\,0\le y\le 2,\,y\le x\le 2\}.
$$

Notice that the top boundary of the region, written in the form $x=x(y),$ is

$$
x=y\,⟹\,y=x,
$$

and the bottom boundary is

$$
y=0.
$$

To change the order of integration, we write $D$ as a type I region. Its type I representation is

$$
D=\{(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le 2,\,0\le y\le x\},
$$

as shown in the diagram below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14226206/assets/4452d48cac6bd387e8f7f27a9aedfbe51f9c5e478a5288f889aa3378c4805d34.png)

Therefore, swapping the order of integration, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{y}^{2}{e}^{-{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{x}{e}^{-{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{e}^{-{x}^{2}}[{\int }_{0}^{x}\text{d}y]\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}{e}^{-{x}^{2}}[y]_{0}^{x}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{2}x{e}^{-{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={[-\frac{1}{2}{e}^{-{x}^{2}}]}_{0}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(1-{e}^{-4}).\end{aligned}
$$
